summary: The Go kvstore lacks an SDK lifecycle and detector-ready diagnostics for asynchronous persistence, index pressure, and capacity eviction.
flow: audit -> select -> instrument -> verify -> configure/dashboard -> publish

signal_flow.component_flow_map:
cmd/kvstore-server [GAP: Provider and resource lifecycle] -> HTTP handlers [GAP: HTTP route telemetry] -> request logs [GAP: Local application log pipeline]
Go process [GAP: Go runtime and host metrics]
Store persistence/index/eviction [GAP: Store async diagnostics]

incident_readiness.required_signals: One provider/resource lifecycle with OTLP export, W3C propagation, and shutdown flush
incident_readiness.impact: No selected telemetry can emit reliably without this prerequisite.

incident_readiness.required_signals: Persistence failure, index queue pressure, and capacity eviction metrics
incident_readiness.impact: Successful API responses can hide later data-loss, stale-search, or eviction symptoms.

findings.title: Server startup lacks OTel provider and resource lifecycle
findings.gap: No OTel providers, resource merge, propagator, exporters, or shutdown flush are reachable from the server entrypoint.
findings.impact: Selected service-owned telemetry cannot emit with stable identity or flush reliably.
findings.product_outcome: One consistent kvstore identity and export lifecycle
findings.required_fix: Initialize OTel once before serving, preserve operator resource settings, configure trace and metric export from environment, install W3C propagation, and flush on shutdown without hardcoding a cloud endpoint.
acceptance_criteria: Exactly one SDK lifecycle starts before serving and flushes during shutdown.
Trace and metric endpoints remain operator-configurable; no cloud endpoint is hardcoded.
constraints: Do not initialize providers from package init or request paths.
Preserve operator-provided service.name and resource attributes.
follow_up_actions: Select this prerequisite with dependent executable findings.

findings.title: HTTP API lacks route-level telemetry
findings.gap: The net/http routes have no route-aware OTel server instrumentation.
findings.impact: Latency and errors cannot be attributed to bounded route patterns.
findings.required_fix: Add one route-aware server instrumentation layer and bounded HTTP metrics.
acceptance_criteria: Requests emit route-aware server telemetry without raw keys in attributes.
constraints: Preserve route behavior and exclude concrete keys.
follow_up_actions: Select this finding separately when route coverage is approved.

findings.title: Application logs lack local OTel export and correlation
findings.gap: Existing application logs have no local OTel provider/exporter/bridge.
findings.impact: Persistence and request failures cannot be correlated through OTel logs.
findings.product_outcome: Local application logs correlated with active traces
findings.required_fix: Add one official Go logging bridge and local OTLP log path while preserving stdout.
acceptance_criteria: One request-context log exports locally with trace and span correlation while stdout remains active.
constraints: Do not duplicate records or send application logs directly to cloud.
follow_up_actions: Select with its route-context dependency when correlated logs are approved.

findings.title: Go runtime and host metrics are missing
findings.gap: The service has no Go runtime or process saturation metrics.
findings.impact: Operators cannot separate runtime pressure from store failures.
findings.required_fix: Enable official Go runtime and host metrics through the shared provider.
acceptance_criteria: A focused collection observes runtime metrics with stable service resource attributes.
constraints: Use official runtime instrumentation rather than custom duplicates.
follow_up_actions: Select separately when runtime saturation coverage is approved.

findings.title: Async store internals lack detector-ready diagnostics
findings.gap: Async persistence, buffered indexing, and capacity eviction have no low-cardinality detector inputs.
findings.impact: Accepted writes can later fail, search can lag, or entries can be evicted without a detector-ready signal.
findings.product_outcome: Persistence, backlog, and eviction incident detection
findings.required_fix: Add app-owned metrics for persistence outcome, real index queue pressure, and capacity eviction with bounded dimensions.
acceptance_criteria: A forced persistence failure emits kvstore.persistence.operations with bounded operation, outcome=failure, and reason.
A deterministic pressure path emits nonzero kvstore.index.queue.depth with bounded workflow.
Capacity eviction emits kvstore.evictions with reason=capacity and no concrete key.
constraints: Do not attach keys, paths, values, search terms, request IDs, goroutine IDs, or error text.
Do not change store behavior to create telemetry; prove non-default observable state and run go test -race ./....
follow_up_actions: Select this finding to instrument and verify all three audited store scenarios.

environments.prerequisites: Go toolchain and module dependency access

scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Startup initializes one lifecycle with operator-preserved service identity.
Shutdown flushes every configured provider exactly once.
The request emits HTTP telemetry with a route template and no raw key.

scenarios.expected_signals: One local log with active trace correlation
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The record retains its console sink and exports once with trace and span IDs.

scenarios.trigger: Collect from the shared meter provider
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: Collection includes a nonempty official runtime metric.

scenarios.trigger: Force the persistence seam to fail
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The datapoint has bounded operation, outcome=failure, and reason attributes.

scenarios.trigger: Deterministically fill or block the index queue
scenarios.acceptance_criteria: The observed queue depth is nonzero and only workflow is dimensional.
The datapoint has reason=capacity and no concrete key.

anti_patterns: Metric attributes containing keys, values, paths, queries, request IDs, goroutine IDs, or error text.
recommendation: Select approved audit IDs, save the bound selection, then run $otel-instrument for that exact scope.
